text.description_html:
1-1/2 Diameter Teak Pull with Polished Stainless Sleeve

From the new First Impressions Teak wood collection this contemporary styled door handle combines the warmth and beauty of solid Teak wood with contemporary solid brass mounting brackets and polished stainless steel sleeve. Hand made in the USA by the expert craftsmen at First Impressions International.

Teak is used for these door pulls because of its hard, strong, durable characteristics. It is also resistant to insects and warping, even when exposed directly to harsh weather, making it the ideal choice for exterior doors.

The Teak handle is unstained in its natural color. Staining is not required. Great door pull handle for commercial doors or residential doors.

Specifications for First Impressions WOOD/44 Door Pull

  • Overall Pull Length: 44"
  • Length of Sleeve: 12"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Bracket Diameter: 15/16"
  • Total Projection: 3"
  • Pull Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Material: Solid Teak
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Forged Brass
  • Pull Sleeve Material: Polished stainless steel

Note: This First Impression door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard for Thrubolt mounting (Bolts through the door).

*Sold individually.
